text: The 2021 tree-cover loss was almost entirely within the pine plantation. Of the total 81.3 hectares lost, 98% (68.1 ha) was confirmed as planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda) by MGAP’s 2021 forest map. Only 13.2 hectares of the loss area fell outside mapped forest boundaries. The event was corroborated by Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020 data, with no native forest involved. Thus, the loss was overwhelmingly within the plantation.
